reviews.text: Bermuda cruise. The ship and crew are quite nice. The food was delicious wherever we ate from the buffet to the specialty restaurants. There were plenty of activities and a variety of entertainment to choose from all day long. However, we were disappointed daily by the poor internet service available through the basic plan. We also didn’t have enough electrical outlets in our cabin. Especially frustrating was the fact that there were no outlets near the bed for C-Pap machines. An extension cord was provided to compensate for this, but running cords across the room between the bed and the bathroom was a tripping hazard. We are not likely to book another cruise on Celebrity.

reviews.text:
A Seamless and Spectacular Experience Aboard the Celebrity Edge. From the moment we checked in to the final farewell, our cruise on the Celebrity Edge was nothing short of exceptional like a well-oiled machine operating at peak performance.
The embarkation and disembarkation process was incredibly smooth, efficient, and stress-free. We were immediately impressed by the friendly, professional, and knowledgeable crew, who consistently went above and beyond to ensure every moment of our journey was enjoyable.

There was a wide variety of onboard activities to choose from, catering to every interest and energy level. Whether you wanted to join in or simply relax, there was something for everyone. The evening shows were superb high-quality entertainment every night.

A special thank you to Captain Matt, Cruise Director Dave, and Activities Director Ana, whose leadership and attention to guest experience ensured that our every want and wish was met with warmth and precision.

One of our favorite spaces onboard was the Aqua Spa a tranquil retreat where we could unwind and soak in the serenity. Our room steward, Mayan, was absolutely outstanding: accommodating, efficient, and always professional. Our room was always pristine and inviting.

We dined in Blu, which offered consistently great dinner options. While breakfast was more standard, the overall experience was still pleasant. A special shout-out to Philipe, whose friendliness and attentiveness stood out he was kind and engaging without ever being intrusive. His service partner, Wedana, was equally kind and attentive, making every meal feel personalized and special.

The ports of call were well-selected, and the excursions were thoughtfully planned and expertly executed. A few highlights:

Bear watching in Ketchikan turned into an incredible wildlife experience we saw whales, seals, a mink, and even a bear (from afar)!
Kayaking to Mendenhall Glacier in Juneau was absolutely breathtaking an unforgettable adventure.
Sailing through Endicott Arm and Dawes Glacier was a masterclass in navigation, and we were blessed with the most beautiful weather throughout.
This cruise has truly set a new standard for us, and we’re already looking forward to booking our next sailing with Celebrity.
